title: U.S. Market Morning
summary: U.S. equity futures, Treasury yields, the dollar and overnight global markets set the pre-market tone, while liquid and volatile U.S.-listed stocks lead the activity watch.
narration: Good morning. This is ShareCapsule Radio's U.S. market briefing. U.S. equity futures, Treasury yields, the dollar, and overnight global markets form today's pre-market setup. The active-stock watch prioritizes liquidity, volatility, pre-market movement, options activity, earnings, and verified company news. This demonstration uses illustrative figures and is not live market data. ShareCapsule Radio is provided solely for educational and informational purposes. drivers.title: Treasury yields set the valuation tone
drivers.detail: Track the U.S. two-year and ten-year yields before treating equity-futures direction as a durable signal.

drivers.title: Pre-market breadth tests index strength

drivers.title: Dollar and crude transmit global risk
drivers.detail: Moves in the dollar and oil can reshape inflation expectations, multinational earnings sensitivity and sector leadership.

drivers.title: Verified company catalysts drive active names
drivers.detail: Earnings, guidance, SEC filings, analyst actions and unusual volume receive more weight than unverified social-media attention.
